messages:
incident-bot: Page fired -> PD #INC-8854 for service=inference-gateway region=eu-west1 metric=5xx_rate threshold=15% above baseline. Auto-ack window=60s. Link: https://pd.example/INC-8854 :rotating_light:

pagerduty-bot: Incident created · priority=high · escalation policy=oncall-sre · responder=aj (oncall)

aj (oncall): acked. jumping on it. reading the alert — 502s across edge -> origin, not just single host. pulling traces.

maria (SRE): seeing a ~18% spike in 502s starting 03:17UTC, sharp onset. Affected routes: /v1/generate and /v1/stream. Impact: intermittent failures for EU customers, some retries causing higher latency.

emily (support): getting 3 slack threads / one support ticket reporting user-facing failures (customers in EU). letting CS know it's paged.

aj (oncall): quick check — health on primaries looks green but backend returns a few 502s. hitting one host:
```
$ curl -i https://inference-eu.internal/v1/generate -H 'Authorization: Bearer REDACT'
HTTP/1.1 502 Bad Gateway
Server: envoy
Date: Tue, 15 Mar 2026 03:20:12 GMT
Content-Type: application/json
{"error":"upstream connect error: connection reset by peer"}
```

samir (eng-runtime): logs show a pattern of keepalive resets from the LB to the model workers around the spike. suspecting connection churn after recent LB config tweak yesterday. will check kernel/tcp defaults on model hosts.

leo (infra): rolling back the LB keepalive timeout change that shipped last night to canary first. triggering rollback to previous backend config. running: `gcloud compute backend-services update-backend my-backend --global --remove-backend=...` (internal ops).

maria (SRE): running the runbook step: route traffic away from unhealthy backends via weight-adjust. applying temporary weight shift to backup pool in eu-west1 and enable cross-region failover to eu-north1 for high-priority routes.

aj (oncall): applied weight shift. Monitoring. Adding a short circuit-breaker on client retries to avoid thundering herd (set retry-policy max_attempts=1 for now).

emily (support): updating affected customers: "We're aware of intermittent 502s in EU; engineers are rolling mitigations. We'll post updates every 15m."

samir (eng-runtime): found repeated `RST` from load-balancer to worker on 10.12.8.34. Kernel dmesg shows `tcp: possible SYN flood` messages — but counts are modest. suspect LB configured too-low idle timeout causing resets on long-lived connections (kv cache/prefix use).

leo (infra): canary rollback completed. primary roll back in progress across all eu backends (ETA ~6m).

maria (SRE): after canary rollback, 502 rate dropped 60% on the canary cohort. continuing rollout.

aj (oncall): rolling back LB config fully now. also enabling k/v cache pre-warm on backup hosts to reduce miss tail.

emily (support): customers on high-touch list notified that failover is in progress and errors are decreasing.

samir (eng-runtime): added a short-term mitigation in runtime: increase keepalive_probes and extend idle timeout to avoid premature resets while infra rolls back. patch deployed to 4 hosts in eu-west1.

maria (SRE): metrics show 5xx back to baseline in eu-west1 after rollback and runtime tweak. still watching for regressions.

aj (oncall): posting incident summary for handoff in 30m. if stable for 15m, will close PD alert and hand to follow-on rotation for postmortem.

leo (infra): root cause candidate = LB idle timeout change + long-lived kv cache connections => unexpected resets -> 502s. will prepare rollback notes + PR to standardize keepalive defaults.

samir (eng-runtime): collecting heap/connection stats for model workers and saving logs to s3://redwood-incidents/INC-8854/ for postmortem.

emily (support): queued customer follow-ups. will include timeline and mitigation once we have consolidated postmortem.

aj (oncall): marking incident as mitigated. PD: set status=acknowledged -> resolved in 20m if no further spike. handing to maria for postmortem next steps. :white_check_mark:

maria (SRE): will open a postmortem ticket, assign RCA owners, and coordinate changelog with infra. thanks everyone, great quick ops.

incident-bot: Automated note: next oncall rotation in 30m — please confirm handoff if you're taking post-incident actions.
